topics.title: JavaScript
topics.description: Understand what JavaScript is, how it is executed, where it fits within runtimes and software systems, and the problems it is commonly used to solve.

topics.title: TypeScript
topics.description: Learn how TypeScript extends JavaScript with static typing, type inference, generics, interfaces, advanced types, and tooling to build scalable and maintainable applications.

topics.title: Node.js
topics.description: Understand what Node.js is, how it executes JavaScript, where it fits in modern software systems, and the problems it is designed to solve.

topics.title: Express
topics.description: Learn what Express is, how it works, where it fits within backend architectures, and the most common ways it is used to build web applications and APIs.

topics.title: NestJS
topics.description: Module boundaries, dependency injection, request execution, validation, and testing in one connected reading.

topics.title: React
topics.description: Learn what React is, how it builds user interfaces from reusable components, where it fits within frontend architectures, and the most common ways it is used in modern applications.

topics.title: Next.js
topics.description: Understand what Next.js is, why it exists, and how it extends React to build production-ready web applications with server-side capabilities, optimized rendering, and modern full-stack features.

topics.title: Tailwind CSS
topics.description: Understand what Tailwind CSS is, why it exists, and how its utility-first approach enables developers to build consistent, responsive, and highly customizable user interfaces without writing traditional CSS for every component.

topics.title: Jest
topics.description: Learn what Jest is, why it exists, how it fits into modern software development, and how it helps developers build reliable JavaScript and TypeScript applications through automated testing.

topics.title: @nestjs/swagger
topics.description: Understand how @nestjs/swagger integrates OpenAPI with NestJS, generates API descriptions from application metadata, and exposes them to documentation and API tooling.

topics.title: HTTP
topics.description: Learn what HTTP is, how applications exchange information, where HTTP fits within modern software architectures, and how it enables communication across the web.

topics.title: REST
topics.description: Understand REST as an architectural style, its resource-oriented model, architectural constraints, place in modern software systems, and common use cases.

topics.title: OpenAPI
topics.description: Understand OpenAPI as a standard for describing HTTP APIs, how API descriptions work, where they fit in the development ecosystem, and their common use cases.

topics.title: OAuth 2.0
topics.description: Learn what OAuth 2.0 is, why delegated authorization exists, how applications obtain limited access to protected resources, and where OAuth fits within modern software architectures.

topics.title: OpenID Connect
topics.description: Understand what OpenID Connect is, how applications authenticate users, and how identity information is securely shared using OAuth 2.0 and JWT.

topics.title: JWT
topics.description: Understand what JSON Web Tokens are, why they exist, how they carry verifiable claims between systems, and where they fit within modern application architectures.

topics.title: API Keys
topics.description: Understand what API Keys are, how they associate requests with clients or projects, and where they fit within API access and security.

topics.title: Sessions & Cookies
topics.description: Understand how web applications maintain user state across multiple HTTP requests using sessions and cookies.

topics.title: TLS
topics.description: Understand what TLS is, why secure communication is necessary, how TLS protects data, and why it has become the standard protocol for secure communication on the Internet.

topics.title: PostgreSQL
topics.description: Learn what PostgreSQL is, how it stores and retrieves persistent data, where it fits in modern software architectures, and the most common ways it is used.

topics.title: MongoDB
topics.description: Learn what MongoDB is, how it stores and queries data, where it fits within modern application architectures, and the most common scenarios in which document databases are used.

topics.title: Redis
topics.description: Understand what Redis is, why in-memory databases exist, and how applications achieve extremely fast data access.

topics.title: RabbitMQ
topics.description: Understand why message queues exist, how asynchronous communication works, and how RabbitMQ enables reliable communication between distributed services.

topics.title: Apache Kafka
topics.description: Understand why event streaming platforms exist, how Kafka stores immutable event logs, and how distributed systems process events at massive scale.

topics.title: AWS IAM
topics.description: Understand what AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is, how it authorizes access to AWS resources, and why it serves as the foundation of security across nearly every AWS service.

topics.title: AWS Lambda
topics.description: Learn what AWS Lambda is, why it exists, how serverless computing works, and how Lambda fits into modern cloud architectures.

topics.title: AWS API Gateway
topics.description: Learn what Amazon API Gateway is, why it exists, how it manages API traffic, and how it fits into modern cloud architectures.

topics.title: Docker
topics.description: Understand what Docker is, why containers exist, how they work, and why Docker became the standard platform for packaging and running applications consistently across environments.

topics.title: HMAC
topics.description: Understand what HMAC is, why it is used, and where message authentication fits within secure application architectures.

topics.title: Prisma
topics.description: Data access, relations, transactions, and safe schema migrations.

topics.title: VS Code Debugger

topics.title: ESLint

topics.title: Zod

topics.title: Testcontainers

topics.title: Git
